offering_description.value: Designs, builds and sells single-family homes, townhomes and condominiums, mainly to entry-level, first-time and first move-up buyers. Also provides mortgage, title and insurance services to its homebuyers through financial services subsidiaries.

primary_products.value: single-family detached homes; townhomes; condominiums; residential lots

primary_services.value: mortgage financing; title services; insurance agency services

customer_segment.value: B2C: entry-level, first-time and move-up homebuyers, plus active adult buyers

end_markets.value: residential housing; entry-level and move-up homes; active adult housing

revenue_model.value: product sales: sale of newly built homes and some lots to buyers; service fees: mortgage origination, title and insurance fees from homebuyers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: acquires land and builds homes using subcontractors and purchased materials, sold to homebuyers; financial intermediary: mortgage origination and title services for its homebuyers

geography_served.value: US national: Western, Mountain, Texas, Southeast and Midwest states, including Colorado, Texas, Florida, Georgia, Arizona and Washington

specialization.value: related lines: homebuilding with affiliated mortgage, title and insurance services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: on-site sales staff at community model homes; agents / brokers: third-party real estate brokers representing buyers; online: website and digital lead generation for home sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land use, zoning, environmental and building codes, mortgage lending rules such as CFPB and RESPA
